policy: Original annual statements locked for2019–21 because later comparative XBRL had wrong signs/periods. Otherwise latest eligible10-K context by exact fiscal end and330–400-day annual duration; premerger accounting predecessor selected explicitly. Blank/null means unavailable. No unreported debt/lease/tax item is silently zero. Narrow NWC excludes prepaids, othercurrent and noncurrent assets/liabilities; capital/ROIC are diagnostic proxies, not comprehensive normalized economic invested capital. No R&D capitalization. Acquired amortization kept separate from physical depreciation. v2 preserves original predecessor R&D and adds a separately sourced comparable classification; selected-data manual observations are identified separately from XBRL facts. FY2020 has361inclusive days. Neither correction changes reported EBIT or forecast DCF.
